blocks.html:
This method requests a reset password token for an admin user, customer, or custom actor type.
It sends a request to the [Generate Reset Password Token API route](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#auth\_postactor\_typeauth\_providerresetpassword).

To reset the password later using the token delivered to the user, use the [updateProvider](/references/js-sdk/auth/updateProvider) method.

Related guide: [How to allow customers to reset their passwords in a storefront](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/storefront-development/customers/reset-password).

types.name: actor
types.description: The actor type. For example, `user` for admin user, or `customer` for customer.

types.name: provider
types.description: The authentication provider to use. For example, `emailpass`.

types.name: body
types.description: The data required to identify the user.

children.name: identifier
children.description:
The user's identifier. For example, when using the `emailpass` provider,
this would be the user's email.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Optional metadata to include in the reset password request.
